Items.VisaStory: Anna has a long-term student visa valid for two years, issued for her Master's program at TU Berlin.
Items.BudgetStory: She receives 500 EUR monthly from a DAAD scholarship and can afford moderate housing.
Items.EnrollmentStory: Currently enrolled in Computer Science at TU Berlin, starting her second semester.

Items.VisaStory: Carlos is on a 3-month exchange program with a short-term Schengen visa.
Items.BudgetStory: His family sends him 300 EUR per month, so he needs the cheapest option available.
Items.EnrollmentStory: Enrolled as an exchange student at HU Berlin for the summer semester.

Items.VisaStory: Yuki holds a long-term visa for her PhD research at FU Berlin, valid for four years.
Items.BudgetStory: Her research grant provides 1200 EUR monthly, giving her flexibility in housing choices.
Items.EnrollmentStory: Enrolled in the Biology doctoral program at FU Berlin.

Items.VisaStory: Tom is visiting Berlin for a 2-month language course, holding a short-term tourist visa.
Items.BudgetStory: He saved up before the trip and has about 800 EUR per month for accommodation.
Items.EnrollmentStory: Not enrolled in any university program. Attending a private language school.

Items.VisaStory: Fatima received a long-term student visa after being accepted into the medical program at Charite.
Items.BudgetStory: Living on a tight budget of 320 EUR from part-time work at the university library.
Items.EnrollmentStory: First-year medical student at Charite, enrolled full-time.
